Impact Summary
                                                                                                                                                                                                      
From 30 March 2026 21:00 UTC to 30 March 2026 22:57 UTC, customers using Databricks in AWS experienced failures starting clusters and running workloads. 

Symptoms

Customers experienced:
  - Classic clusters failing to start
  - Jobs and pipelines are unable to launch
  - Notebook clusters are not becoming available

Current Status

This incident has been fully resolved as of 22:57 UTC on 30 March 2026. Normal service operation has been restored. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com. 

Next Update

No further updates are planned unless conditions change.

incident_description:
Between 11:00 UTC and 13:20 UTC on March 24, 2026, customers using Databricks experienced degraded availability with Serverless Compute. Affected customers may have experienced cluster launch failures and job execution errors.

• Serverless REPL cluster launches may fail to initialize correctly
• Job runs may terminate unexpectedly with DRIVER_UNRESPONSIVE errors
• Clusters may become stuck in restart loops after multiple failures
• New cluster creation may fail during the spin-up process

Recommendations
No customer action is required at this time.

Current Status
This incident has been fully resolved as of 24 March 2026 13:20 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

incident_name: US East 1 - Multiple services (Partial Service Disruption)
incident_description:
From 13 March 2026 21:21 UTC to 13 March 2026 22:11 UTC, customers using Databricks SQL, Unity Catalog, and dependent services in AWS us-east-1 experienced service disruptions. All services are now restored

Symptoms

Customers experienced:
- Unity Catalog operations failing, including data access and permission checks
- Databricks SQL queries failing or not completing
- Mosaic AI Vector Search requests failing
- System Tables (Lineage) requests failing

Current Status

This incident has been fully resolved as of 13 March 2026 22:11 UTC. We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused. If you require further details about this incident, please submit a support ticket or contact help@databricks.com.

Next Update

No further updates are planned unless conditions change.
